title: RAGAS: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
snippet: RAGAS (Retrieval Augmented Generation Assessment) is a framework for reference-free evaluation of RAG pipelines. It evaluates faithfulness, answer relevance, and context relevance using an LLM-based judge without requiring ground-truth answers.

title: ARES: An Automated Evaluation Framework for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
snippet: ARES provides automated evaluation of RAG systems using fine-tuned judge models with statistical confidence intervals, reducing human annotation effort while maintaining correlation with human judgments on context relevance, answer faithfulness, and answer relevance.

title: RAGChecker: A Fine-grained Framework for Diagnosing Retrieval-Augmented Generation
snippet: RAGChecker is a fine-grained evaluation framework with both holistic metrics and diagnostic metrics, enabling detailed diagnosis of retrieval and generation failures in RAG systems.

title: TruLens — open source LLM observability and evaluation
snippet: TruLens is an open source software library for evaluating and tracking LLM applications, including RAG triad feedback functions: context relevance, groundedness, and answer relevance.

title: DeepEval — The LLM evaluation framework
snippet: DeepEval is an open-source LLM evaluation framework with unit testing of LLM applications, supporting metrics such as faithfulness, answer relevancy, contextual precision and recall, hallucination, and toxicity.

title: A Survey on Evaluation of Large Language Models and Generation Tasks
snippet: Survey covering evaluation methods and benchmarks for LLMs and generation tasks, including human evaluation, automated metrics, and LLM-as-judge approaches with their limitations.

title: LangSmith Evaluation Overview
snippet: LangSmith provides evaluation tools for LLM applications including datasets, evaluators, and online evaluation, supporting both LLM-as-judge and custom heuristic evaluators.

title: Azure AI evaluation metrics
snippet: Microsoft's evaluation tooling provides groundedness, relevance, and coherence metrics for generative AI applications with integrated safety evaluations.

title: Improving RAG evaluation — key metrics
snippet: LangChain guidance on evaluating RAG pipelines: context relevance, faithfulness/groundedness, and answer relevance, with dataset construction and evaluator guidance.

title: Giskard — Open-source LLM vulnerability scanning and evaluation
snippet: Giskard is an open-source framework for testing LLM applications, detecting performance bugs, hallucinations, and harmful content through automated scanning and human feedback.

title: Production RAG: evaluation and monitoring practices
snippet: LlamaIndex blog and documentation on building production RAG systems, covering retrieval evaluation, quality metrics, and observability considerations.

title: RAG evaluation with vector databases
snippet: Practical guide to evaluating RAG pipelines using vector databases, including retrieval hit-rate, MRR, and generation quality metrics.

title: LLM evaluation approaches for customer support automation
snippet: Overview of LLM evaluation approaches for support automation, discussing metric selection, dataset curation, and continuous monitoring.
